question: Where is the native default controller-family byte produced, and what exact label interface do the selected glyph movies consume?

scope.boundary: The native producer and movie-side label consumers are separate bounded results. No selected native reader joins the config byte to those consumers.

dependencies.use: generic external-image creation and distinct texture layers
by-name type-11 opener and cache/fallback qualification
closed input event chain and glyph-owner selection limits
documented version-6 index and registered ASCII case-folding

currentEvidence.method: Bounded package-index and selected GFX tag/AVM1 parsing, serialized foreground tools/run-headless.ps1 -ReadOnly queries, supported-image word equality and narrow exact-owner generated corroboration.

configBoundary.producerResult: The wrapper forwards the key, byte destination, supplied default and description. The inner helper conditionally writes normalized nonzero query output, or calls the default-record helper and writes low8(default).
premises: Required helper calls return and preserve the identified arguments and stack/output storage.
Actual configuration parsing, current byte, call timing and retained state remain unobserved.

preloadBoundary.result: Two selected PS3 image literals are passed to the accepted main-menu named-file preload helper. This is asset availability preparation, not a family selector.

legend.result: SetIcon(number,icon,text) calls this[buttonIcon+number].gotoAndPlay(icon) and assigns the text separately.

buttonLegend.result: SetIcon consumes an icon label separately from text. Five named root buttonIcon instances use sprite 97; the movie has no tag-1001 or standard bitmap tags.

movieConsumerBoundary.downVariantQualification: The three selected extended glyph sprites explicitly place a nested external-image shape using the PS3 up-direction image within their PS3 down-label interval. Matrix/rotation semantics are not interpreted; a same-named down DDS is not required by those inspected bindings.

wordIdentity.qualification: All selected words match the supported flat image; this proves neither runtime execution nor repaired-thunk behavior.

boundedNegatives.premise: Decoded references and aligned exact pointer words to the description were queried.
boundedNegatives.result: Neither model found a description reference. A subsequent raw split-materializer query found the exact registrar, so the initial negatives did not establish absence.

boundedNegatives.premise: Raw lbz/stb displacement 0xE866 masked with 0xFC00FFFF over program words.
boundedNegatives.result: Zero matches for either form. Aliased bases, other displacements, pointer-indirect accesses and unrecognized forms remain outside coverage.

boundedNegatives.premise: Raw lis/addi-or-ori split-materializer model, exact target 0x82F6E866, eight-word lookahead and candidate cap eight.
boundedNegatives.result: One untruncated candidate, the known registrar at 0x82E2D5AC + 0x82E2D5B8. No new reader is selected. Alias/object-relative storage, wider split constructions, spills and pointer-indirect forms remain outside coverage.

loaderAssessment.byName: Accepted descriptor filename -> snapshotted kind-10 opener -> supplied-name type-11 lookup, with ordinary file fallback.
loaderAssessment.fpk: Membership and hashes establish candidate package copies. Selected runtime package, precedence, preload completion and request residency remain unproved.
loaderAssessment.registration: Tag 1001 registers deferred descriptors with the movie definition; selected movie SetIcon consumes timeline labels. No general inline text token syntax or native token registry is established.
loaderAssessment.textureOwnership: Accepted renderer texture has owner+0x1C, dimensions+0x20/+0x24 and backend+0x28. File Data, memory file, movie definition, image resource, renderer texture and backend remain distinct.
loaderAssessment.lifetime: Retained state snapshots and deferred descriptors are known; exact selected resource caching, destruction, renderer release, residency and invalidation are unproved.
loaderAssessment.phase: Tag parsing registers deferred descriptors, and the accepted image-resource creator later opens the supplied filename. Two PS3 literal preload calls are bound. Boot/front-end/screen-entry timing, invocation, completion, reuse and reload for actual glyph instances remain unproved.

feasibility.recommendation: Prefer establishing the native default-family reader and its output label before designing a patch. If that reader honors the native config byte, a startup/restart preference is the first candidate.
feasibility.loadNameRedirect: A fallback candidate can remap selected Xbox external-image names before first movie/resource creation, with target package availability, dimensions and transforms preserved. A first implementation should require restart because live invalidation is unproved; the native minimum reload boundary remains unknown. This does not cover every selected movie consumer.
feasibility.existingFlag: A real byte producer exists for the named native key; its effective glyph-family reader and supported configuration source remain unbound.
feasibility.liveSwitching: Not admitted: reader timing, copied labels, cached movie/image state, texture ownership, release and cache invalidation have no coherent contract.

unproved: Native read of 0x82F6E866 and family-label output.
Exact native Xbox-to-PS3 action mapping, including stick movement versus click and confirm/cancel convention.
Actual config source and successful parsing, initialization order and runtime retention.
Native request/argument registration delivering SetIcon and main-menu icon values.
Inline HUD/unit/help/menu/popup icon census beyond the five selected movies.
Font/sprite/import ownership of buttonLegend artwork beyond the selected label and placement structure.
Actual package provider/precedence and named preload completion for each glyph.
Selected image/texture residency, release and renderer retirement.
Runtime display, input-device detection, automatic switching or frame coherence.
guards: Do not infer native action mapping or family selection from asset presence, preload, label order or a default description.
Do not treat zero exact-form references as an exhaustive reader/writer result.
Do not generalize logo override acceptance or the generic image chain to every glyph consumer.
Do not publish lossless selected asset inventories, movie scripts, raw code, private paths or payloads.
This finding establishes no runtime implementation, displayed glyph, renderer hook or safe live texture swap.
conclusion: The native configuration route has a concrete default-family byte producer, and two selected legend movies consume caller-supplied timeline labels independently of text. Their connection remains the next bounded native-reader question; startup selection is a promising candidate, while live swapping lacks the necessary lifecycle evidence.

staticQuery.qualification: Configured function bodies truncate at the second thunk range. Selected raw words and narrow generated functions supply the admitted local instruction claims; helper completion remains conditional.

assetInventorySummary.result: All supplied names occur with lowercase DDS archive names. The bounded indices include an additional PS3 downward-direction asset, two Xbox axis helpers and two analog helpers. The CSV selects one source row and does not inventory duplicate package copies.
assetInventorySummary.qualification: These are selected-family counts, not complete package inventories. Membership does not establish selected provider, family choice, visible output or safe replacement.

mappingAssessment.facePositions: Xbox A/B/X/Y correspond by physical position to PlayStation cross/circle/square/triangle; confirm/cancel convention remains unproved.
mappingAssessment.shoulders: LB/RB to L1/R1; LT/RT to L2/R2.
mappingAssessment.sticks: LS/RS stick artwork and L3/R3 click artwork remain distinct; original native selection is unbound.
mappingAssessment.directions: Preserve whole-pad versus per-direction artwork and timeline transforms. The selected PS3 down-label bindings use the up image; a separate down asset is package-specific.
mappingAssessment.other: Start/Back to Start/Select; horizontal/vertical axis helpers are separate. Two analog helpers have no established exact replacement.
mappingAssessment.qualification: No native Xbox-to-PS3 pair table or complete action mapping was recovered. Asset-name spelling and label order do not establish a native mapping.

nextQuestion: Does an exact current-image read of 0x82F6E866, including a proven containing-storage alias, choose the current label delivered to a selected SetIcon/gotoAndPlay consumer?
